statement: On ecology-v2, replay prioritization at fixed original motivation improves balanced behavior versus uniform replay after100000 primitive training transitions; longer exposure also tests whether earlier20k negatives were premature.
rationale: Previous20k pilots ended at epsilon.62 and acquired almost no food. Useful acquisition experiences may be rare and diluted in replay; TD-error prioritization can reuse them. Both treatments train100k with unchanged optimizer/network/exploration/discount so the contrast isolates sampling, while learning curves reveal exposure effects. No p4 or persistent exploration.
falsification: No promotion unless prioritized replay improves the worst fixed-criterion ratio by>=10% in>=2/3 paired training seeds and lowers mean hunger by>=.05 in>=2 seeds, without aggregate thermal MAE, proximity or contact worsening>10%. Regardless of the contrast, any learner satisfying every fixed criterion on all3 seeds is eligible for an independent full confirmation. Final100k only; no retrospective best checkpoint choice.

sources.title: Prioritized Experience Replay
sources.sectionsRead: 3.1-3.4, Algorithm1, sections4-5; reread3.3-3.4 at campaign resume
sources.mechanism: Sample transitions proportional to (absolute TD error plus epsilon)^alpha and apply importance weights to reduce sampling bias.
sources.limitations: TD error may reflect stochasticity, not useful novelty. Live's existing implementation uses constant beta.4, epsilon1e-5 and batch-local max-weight normalization rather than the source's annealing beta to1 and global normalization. Optimizer is held fixed for causal isolation, while the paper also adjusted step size. This is a fixed Live implementation study, not a full replication. Historical very short PER pilots were negative in different physics; this new test does not erase them.

protocol.controls: Uniform alpha0, PER alpha.6; original weighted-homeostasis, beta.4, primitive epsilon-greedy duration1; runner random/untrained/initial frozen.
protocol.primary: Per training seed, mean metrics over5 evaluation worlds, then max of the six metric/threshold ratios from unchanged ecology-v2 criteria. Training replicates N=3, not15.
protocol.checkpointRule: Use final100k for decision; report all intermediate policies. No selection by reward or best seed.
protocol.fullRule: New training seeds and new held-out evaluation seeds, fixed final budget, all needs checked per seed/world; do not call pilot confirmation.
protocol.compute: Two CPU workers only while measured RAM leaves reserve2GiB;10min drainable slices, per-trial timeout8min. User explicitly authorizes continued research without a30min cap.
